mapper.sql: select w.webhook_id, w.store_id, s.store_name, w.woo_webhook_id, w.name, w.topic, w.delivery_url, w.secret, w.status, w.last_delivery_time, w.last_delivery_status, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark from yg_shop_webhook w left join yg_shop_store s on s.store_id = w.store_id
mapper.insert: insert into yg_shop_webhook (store_id, woo_webhook_id, name, topic, delivery_url, secret, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{storeId}, #{wooWebhookId}, #{name}, #{topic}, #{deliveryUrl}, #{secret}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}) on duplicate key update name = values(name), topic = values(topic), delivery_url = values(delivery_url), secret = if(values(secret) is null or values(secret) = '', secret, values(secret)), status = values(status), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time), remark = ifnull(values(remark), remark)
mapper.update: update yg_shop_webhook set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where webhook_id = #{webhookId}
